json.overall_experience: The Sales Manager found Help Scout to be an effective tool for managing customer communications, appreciating its ease of use and ability to keep conversations organized within their automotive company. While it excelled at its core function, the manager noted some limitations in advanced sales-specific CRM integrations and reporting capabilities for their role.
